Name: Dwarven Expansion Earthy Buildings
Author: plaidbees
Description:
[size=4][center][size=5]Dwarven Expansion Earthy Buildings[/size][/center][/size]
Changes the appearance of the Coops,  Cave sheds, and Cavern added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22021]mytigio's Dwarven Expansion[/url] mod to match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolor[/url]﻿

I loved the new animals and buildings added by Dwarven Expansion, but with the Earthy Recolor mod they look completely out of place compared to the rest of the world. This mod uses Content Patcher to replace the textures of the buildings to make them fit in better.

[size=4][center]Installing[/center][/size][size=3]Download the mod, unzip the folder and place it into your mod folder.

[/size][center][size=4]Credit﻿[/size][/center][size=3]Thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DaisyNiko/about-me?gameId=1303]DaisyNiko[/url] for allowing the use of their assets in this recolor, to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mytigio/about-me?gameId=1303]mytigo[/url] for making the original buildings and for changing the mods code to make the buildings appearance easier to modify, and to the Stardew Valley Discord's Mod Making channel for helping me get my first real mod working![/size]

Manifest.Name: Dwarven Expansion Earthy Buildings
Manifest.Description: Replaces cave coops, caverns, and sheds with textures matching DaisyNikos Earthy Recolor.
Manifest.Author: Plaidbees
